lines.en: label makotowinterbeach2:
Makoto slides open the door and steps aside to let me in.
lines.zh: Makoto 拉开门，侧身让我进去。

lines.en: I feel mildly impolite for moving past her, but I do so anyway because asking her to go first would defeat the purpose of her holding the door.
lines.zh: 从她身边走过去让我觉得有点失礼，但我还是走了——因为让她先走，就辜负了她帮我扶门的好意。

lines.en: I probably should have just been the one to open it.
lines.zh: 大概本来就该由我来开门。

lines.en: scene mikuisheretoo1
Oh.
lines.zh: 哦。

lines.en: I guess Miku is here?
lines.zh: 看来 Miku 也在？

lines.en: : Uhh...hey.
: Sorry for taggin’ along outta nowhere. I know you and Makoto were tryin’ to spend the weekend alone and stuff.
lines.zh: : 抱歉突然就跟着来了。我知道你和 Makoto 本来想两个人过这个周末之类的。

lines.en: : There’s...no need to apologize.
lines.zh: : 没……没必要道歉。

lines.en: : I’m just a little surprised.
lines.zh: : 我只是有点意外。

lines.en: : But I guess the reason for not being able to do certain things is now a lot clearer.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，为什么有些事做不了，现在清楚多了。

lines.en: : Oh, don’t let me get in the way of anythin’ like that. Just pretend I’m not even here.
lines.zh: : 哦，别因为我耽误那种事。就当我压根不在这儿。

lines.en: : Well, Makoto. You heard her. We can just pretend that she’s not here and-
lines.zh: : 那么，Makoto。你听见了。我们就当她不在这儿，然后——

lines.en: : Sensei...you haven’t even been here for half an hour yet.
lines.zh: : 老师……你到这里连半小时都不到。

lines.en: : Giving up on your promise to be “good” the second Miku says she doesn’t want to get in the way is akin to never having made a promise at all.
lines.zh: : Miku 一说她不想碍事，你立刻就放弃「要乖」的承诺，这跟从来没许过诺没什么两样。

lines.en: : Well said. So let’s throw away the promise and-
lines.zh: : 说得好。那我们就把承诺扔掉，然后——

lines.en: scene mikuisheretoo2
: Ha ha ha.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈。

lines.en: : I’ll allow you to joke while we’re inside, but the second we go back out there, you’re done.
lines.zh: : 在屋里我允许你开玩笑，但我们一走出那扇门，你就完了。

lines.en: : We’re going back out? I thought you were cold?
lines.zh: : 我们还要出去？你不是冷吗？

lines.en: : I am cold. But the pizza we ordered while waiting for you is sure to warm me right up.
lines.zh: : 我是冷。但等你的时候我们叫的披萨，肯定能让我立刻暖起来。

lines.en: scene mikuisheretoo3
: I know I was supposed to wait to start eatin’ but...I couldn’t just leave a whole pizza sittin’ there lookin’ all lonely and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我知道我该等你们一起吃，可是……我总不能让一整块披萨孤零零地摆在那儿吧。

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it. Sensei and I got caught up in a discussion on our way over in the first place.
lines.zh: : 别在意。本来我和老师在过来的路上就聊得起劲。

lines.en: : I knew very well that asking you to wait that long was just...not going to happen.
lines.zh: : 我很清楚，让你等那么久根本……不可能。

lines.en: : Well...since we’re {i}all{/i} here instead of just two of us, what are we going to do now?
lines.zh: : 那么……既然现在是{i}三个人{/i}而不是两个人，我们接下来要做什么？

lines.en: : I know Makoto wanted to talk to me about something, but I don’t know if Miku is also part of-
lines.zh: : 我知道 Makoto 有话想跟我说，但我不知道 Miku 是不是也算——

lines.en: scene mikuisheretoo4
: Oh! I’ll get outta the way now!
lines.zh: : 哦！那我现在就让开！

lines.en: : Like I said, I’m sorry for taggin’ along! It was just a last minute thing and...you know. Stuff.
lines.zh: : 我都说了，很抱歉跟着来！就是最后一刻才决定的，然后……你懂的，那些事。

lines.en: : Yes, I completely understand everything now.
lines.zh: : 对，我现在完全明白了。

lines.en: : Yeah!
: So like...I’ll just go into the other room now and read with...less light.
lines.zh: : 那我就……去另一个房间，用……少一点光看书。

lines.en: scene mikuisheretoo5
: I mean...who needs eyes anyway, right?! Hahahaha!
lines.zh: : 我是说……谁需要眼睛啊，对吧？！哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Miku, you don’t have to-
lines.zh: : Miku，你不用——

lines.en: : Let her go, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 让她去吧，老师。

lines.en: : I already told her that I wanted to spend some time alone with you this weekend {i}to catch up on[school] related things{/i}, so she knew this was coming.
lines.zh: : 我已经告诉她，这个周末我想和你单独待一会儿，{i}补一补[school]相关的事{/i}，所以她早有心理准备。

lines.en: : Yup! Just two of my best buds schedulin’ a winter beach trip to talk about[school]!
lines.zh: : 对！就是我两个最好的哥们儿安排了一次冬季海滩旅行，聊[school]！

lines.en: : It definitely doesn’t sound like she thinks we’ll be talking about-
lines.zh: : 听起来她显然不觉得我们会聊——

lines.en: : School. Which we are. Talking about school is why we’re here.
lines.zh: : 学校。我们就是要聊学校。我们来这儿就是为了聊学校。

lines.en: : Aaaaand on that note, Miku Maruyama...out!
lines.zh: : 那么，就说到这儿，Miku Maruyama……退场！

lines.en: scene mikuisheretoo6
: Have fun...
lines.zh: : 玩得开心……

lines.en: scene mikuisheretoo7
Miku grabs her book and her drink and heads to the bedroom.
lines.zh: Miku 拿起她的书和饮料，走向卧室。

lines.en: I hear the sound of the light clicking on several seconds later as Makoto and I wait for her to get absorbed in whatever manga or comic she’s currently reading.
lines.zh: 几秒钟后我听见灯被打开的声音，而 Makoto 和我等着她沉浸在目前正在看的漫画里。

lines.en: : Would you like any pizza, Sensei? There’s plenty for all of us.
lines.zh: : 你要来点披萨吗，老师？够我们所有人吃的。

lines.en: : I’ll eat later. I’m not hungry right now.
lines.zh: : 我待会儿再吃。现在不饿。

lines.en: scene mikuisheretoo8
: Not eating it now will just cause it to get cold. Are you sure you don’t want to reconsider?
lines.zh: : 现在不吃只会让它变凉。你确定不再考虑一下吗？

lines.en: : Pizza is best when it’s been sitting out at room temperature for about half a day.
lines.zh: : 披萨在室温下放上半天左右最好吃。

lines.en: scene mikuisheretoo9
: I’m sorry, what? That’s completely unsanitary.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你说什么？那完全不卫生啊。

lines.en: : Right. Which is exactly how pizza should be.
lines.zh: : 对。披萨就该是那样的。

lines.en: : You feel free to gorge yourself, though. Even if you decide to eat the entire thing, I won’t think any less of you.
lines.zh: : 不过你尽管放开吃。就算你打算把一整个都吃了，我也不会因此看轻你。

lines.en: : No...you probably should think less of me if I eat the entire thing...
lines.zh: : 不……我要是把一整个都吃了，你大概真该看轻我一点……

lines.en: scene black
Makoto grabs a slice of pizza and places it on a paper plate that she removes from an already opened sleeve of them.
lines.zh: Makoto 拿起一块披萨，放在一个纸盘上——纸盘是她从一叠已经拆开的纸盘里抽出来的。

lines.en: Instead of returning to eat at the table, though, she moves to the back of the room...basically as far as we can get from Miku without finding ourselves in the hall.
lines.zh: 但她没有回桌边吃，而是挪到了房间最里面……基本是我们在不跑到走廊上的前提下，能离 Miku 最远的地方。

lines.en: She motions me over and I follow suit, still trying to get a grip on why she might have decided to sit all the way over here.
lines.zh: 她招手叫我过去，我照做了，心里还在琢磨她为什么偏偏要坐到这么远的地方。

lines.en: scene mikuisheretoo10
: You sure you don’t want any? I’ll let you have the first bite of mine.
lines.zh: : 你确定不要吗？我可以让你先咬我的第一口。

lines.en: : But Makoto, wouldn’t that mean your next bite would be an indirect kiss?
lines.zh: : 可是 Makoto，那样的话你下一口不就成了间接接吻？

lines.en: : We’ve already sworn off things like that for the rest of the weekend.
lines.zh: : 我们可是说好了，这个周末剩下的时间都不干这种事。

lines.en: scene mikuisheretoo11
: I was just trying to be nice. But yes, if you’re going to be weird about it, I won’t offer you anything ever again.
lines.zh: : 我只是想对你好一点。不过行，既然你要这么别扭，我以后什么都不会再给你了。

lines.en: : Now that’s just an overreaction.
lines.zh: : 这就反应过度了。

lines.en: : In fact, I'm starting to think you strategically brought Miku here to prevent me from making a move on you.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我开始觉得你是策略性地把 Miku 带来，好让我没法对你下手。

lines.en: : And this is all one elaborate setup to get closer to me by creating roadblocks or something.
lines.zh: : 而这一切都是一个精心设计的局，靠制造障碍之类的来接近我。

lines.en: : That sounds like a Makoto thing to do.
lines.zh: : 这听起来确实是 Makoto 会干的事。

lines.en: scene mikuisheretoo12
: I understand why you’d think that, but that really isn’t what’s happening here.
lines.zh: : 我理解你为什么会这么想，但事情真不是这样。

lines.en: : Also, try to keep your voice down because I don’t want her to hear us.
lines.zh: : 还有，小声点，我不想让她听见。

lines.en: : We’re probably leaving as soon as I’m done eating anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正我吃完我们大概就要走了。

lines.en: : Sure, yeah.
lines.zh: : 行，好。

lines.en: : If that’s not the reason you brought her, though...what is?
lines.zh: : 不过如果那不是你带她来的原因……那是什么？

lines.en: : You seemed really excited to get away with just the two of us.
lines.zh: : 你之前看起来很期待只有我们两个人出来。

lines.en: Makoto doesn’t respond right away- just looks over at the door separating her from her best friend.
lines.zh: Makoto 没有立刻回答——只是看向那扇把她和她最好的朋友隔开的门。

lines.en: If this were any other weekend, I’m sure that door would be wide open.
lines.zh: 如果是别的周末，我敢肯定那扇门会大敞着。

lines.en: I’m sure the two of them would be spending the night laughing and having pillow fights or doing makeup or...whatever it is [teenage]girls do when they’re locked in confined spaces with one another.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定她们俩会笑着闹一整晚，打枕头仗、化妆，或者……[teenage]女孩被关在一个狭小空间里时会干的任何事。

lines.en: Actually, neither of those two wear a lot of makeup, so cross that one off the list.
lines.zh: 其实她们俩都不怎么化妆，所以那项划掉。

lines.en: The point is, there’s a reason that Miku is separated from us today.
lines.zh: 重点是，今天 Miku 跟我们分开是有原因的。

lines.en: And that reason is...
lines.zh: 而那个原因是……

lines.en: : The second floor of the dorm is very loud, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 宿舍二楼很吵，老师。

lines.en: : We have several...excitable personalities up there always causing a ruckus and-
lines.zh: : 楼上住着几个……特别容易亢奋的人，老是在闹腾，然后——

lines.en: : Well, Miku isn’t good with that sort of thing. Which I know you’re aware of.
lines.zh: : 而 Miku 不太擅长应付这种事。我知道你清楚这一点。

lines.en: : Yeah. It’s not fun to witness.
lines.zh: : 嗯。看着可不好受。

lines.en: scene mikuisheretoo13
: It’s not.
lines.zh: : 是不好受。

lines.en: : It’s one thing if it happens while I’m around as I’ve gotten quite good at dealing with her breakdowns over the years-
lines.zh: : 如果我在场也就算了，这些年来我已经很会处理她崩溃的样子了——

lines.en: : But the thought of her going through something like that on her own is not something I ever want to let happen again.
lines.zh: : 但一想到她要一个人经历那种事，我就绝对不想让它再发生。

lines.en: : It’s happened before?
lines.zh: : 以前发生过？

lines.en: scene mikuisheretoo14
: The last time was right before Christmas.
lines.zh: : 上一次是在圣诞节前不久。

lines.en: : I came home from work to find her barely keeping herself together under the bed.
lines.zh: : 我下班回家，发现她在床底下，勉强撑着没让自己散架。

lines.en: : Poor thing had ripped so much of her hair out that I had to try and salvage it by giving her a new haircut.
lines.zh: : 可怜的家伙把自己扯掉了好多头发，我只好给她剪了个新发型，尽量补救。

lines.en: scene mikuisheretoo15
: Wait, but you guys said you were just giving her a makeover.
lines.zh: : 等等，可你们当时说只是给她做个造型改造。

lines.en: : That is what we said, yes.
lines.zh: : 我们是这么说的，没错。

lines.en: : Well, why would you lie about something like that?
lines.zh: : 那你们为什么要为这种事撒谎？

lines.en: : Why would we come out and tell you something that would make literally everyone in a room full of our peers feel uncomfortable?
lines.zh: : 我们干嘛要主动说出一件事，让一屋子同龄人里每一个人都觉得不舒服？

lines.en: : Good point.
lines.zh: : 有道理。

lines.en: : But that really brings up the question of what else you’ve been hiding from me.
lines.zh: : 不过这确实带出了一个问题——你们还瞒了我什么。

lines.en: scene mikuisheretoo16
: A lot. And part of why I wanted to get together with you here was to come clean about that.
lines.zh: : 很多。我想和你在这里见面的部分原因，就是想把这些都说清楚。

lines.en: : There are plenty of things that I'm constantly implying and praying that you’ll pick up on...which you never do, by the way-
lines.zh: : 有太多东西我一直在暗示，祈祷你能察觉……顺便说一句，你从来没有察觉过——

lines.en: : But there are also plenty of things that I’ve been keeping to myself.
lines.zh: : 但也有很多事我一直只藏在心里。

lines.en: scene mikuisheretoo17
: My only worry is that coming out and talking about those things might change your opinion of me.
lines.zh: : 我唯一担心的是，把这些说出来可能会改变你对我的看法。

lines.en: : But, after a heavy analysis of our relationship conducted over the course of several months, I’ve deduced that you think barely anything of me at all.
lines.zh: : 不过，在花了好几个月对我们的关系做了大量的分析之后，我得出的结论是：你根本没怎么把我放在心上。

lines.en: : That I’ve been nothing but a tool for you to use as you please and-
lines.zh: : 我对你来说不过是个可以随意使用的工具，而且——

lines.en: : Hey. Calm down. It’s not like that.
lines.zh: : 嘿。冷静点。不是那样的。

lines.en: scene mikuisheretoo18
: Well then what is it?
lines.zh: : 那是什么？

lines.en: : Why do you think so little of me even though I do so much for you?
lines.zh: : 我为你做了那么多，你为什么这么不把我当回事？

lines.en: : It’s really frustrating, you know?
lines.zh: : 这真的很让人沮丧，你知道吗？

lines.en: : I’m tearing up with a slice of pizza in my hand right now. It’s not normal.
lines.zh: : 我现在手里拿着一块披萨在哭。这不正常。

lines.en: : I think you’re a great girl, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你是个很棒的女孩，Makoto。

lines.en: : You’re extremely talented and your dedication to me is almost laughably stern.
lines.zh: : 你非常有才华，而你对我的那种执着，严肃得几乎有点好笑。

lines.en: : Like, you’d be one of the first people I’d come to if I ever had to bury a body.
lines.zh: : 比如说，如果哪天我要埋一具尸体，你肯定是我最先想到的人之一。

lines.en: : Is that...supposed to make me feel better?
lines.zh: : 这……是打算让我好受点吗？

lines.en: : In a roundabout way, yeah. Yeah it is.
lines.zh: : 绕了个弯，是啊。是啊，就是。

lines.en: : I’m not doing those things because I want to hurt you, it’s just...
lines.zh: : 我做那些事不是因为想伤害你，只是……

lines.en: : ...Just what?
lines.zh: : ……只是什么？

lines.en: : Sorry. I’m trying to think of a way to say it that won’t make me sound like an asshole.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我在想怎么说才不会让自己听起来像个混蛋。

lines.en: scene mikuisheretoo19
: I already foresee you failing miserably...so just come out and say it.
lines.zh: : 我已经预见到你会惨败……所以干脆直说吧。

lines.en: : I’ve already told myself I’d try to put an end to it, so if hearing your motivations helps me do that...I want to hear them.
lines.zh: : 我已经跟自己说过要试着结束这一切，所以如果听到你的动机能帮我做到……我想听。

lines.en: : It will also help me discern whether or not {i}I{/i} am the root cause in all of this. Just please...help me understand.
lines.zh: : 这也能帮我判断，{i}我{/i}是不是这一切的根源。求你了……帮我弄明白。

lines.en: I said something earlier, albeit in the form of a monologue, about how relationships become pointless once one of the parties no longer has anything left to give.
lines.zh: 我之前说过一句话，虽然是独白的形式——当其中一方再也没有任何东西可以给的时候，关系就变得毫无意义。

lines.en: But it appears that we’ve run into a situation where I may or may not have already taken everything this bluejay has to offer.
lines.zh: 但看起来我们碰上了这么个情况：这只蓝松鸦能给的一切，我可能已经拿光了，也可能还没有。

lines.en: And so the logical thing to do would be to repair its wings so it can fly around and gather more sticks and berries or...do whatever it is birds do while they’re not shitting on cars.
lines.zh: 所以合乎逻辑的做法是修好它的翅膀，让它能飞出去多捡些树枝和浆果，或者……干点鸟在不往车上拉屎的时候会干的事。

lines.en: Birds are so interesting, aren’t they?
lines.zh: 鸟真是有趣，不是吗？

lines.en: Apart from the shitting, I mean.
lines.zh: 除了拉屎那部分，我是说。

lines.en: They’re like humans but with hollow bones.
lines.zh: 它们就像人类，只不过骨头是空的。

lines.en: : Well, it’s an anticlimactic answer, but I really just...have fun messing with you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这个答案有点扫兴，但我真的只是……捉弄你很有意思。

lines.en: : I have fun when you do that, too...
lines.zh: : 你那么做的时候我也开心……

lines.en: : But there are certain times...and a lot of them, might I add, where I want you to really just talk to me and treat me like a human being.
lines.zh: : 但有些时候——而且我得说，还挺多的——我真的只想你好好跟我说说话，把我当个人看。

lines.en: scene mikuisheretoo20
: And...I’m not saying I want to go back to just being another student of yours either. I like what we’ve become sometimes.
lines.zh: : 而且……我也不是说想回到只是你又一个学生的状态。有时候我喜欢我们现在的样子。

lines.en: : I like how you can come to my room and...go on spontaneous beach trips in the middle of winter with me where I drag my friend along out of fear for her safety.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你能来我的房间，还能……在隆冬里和我来一场说走就走的海滩旅行，而我因为担心朋友的安全把她一起拖来。

lines.en: : I’m just saying that sometimes people who you don’t expect to be hurting can be hurting a lot.
lines.zh: : 我只是想说，有时候那些你以为不会受伤的人，可能正伤得很重。

lines.en: : Even when they shouldn’t be.
lines.zh: : 哪怕他们本不该如此。

lines.en: : Yeah.
: I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 对不起。

lines.en: scene mikuisheretoo21
: Woah. Was that a real apology?
lines.zh: : 哇哦。那是真心的道歉吗？

lines.en: : It was.
: I didn’t realize you knew how to do that.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你还会这一手。

lines.en: : I’m full of surprises. It’s just usually better for everyone if I keep them locked away.
lines.zh: : 我浑身都是惊喜。只不过通常来说，把它们锁起来对大家都更好。

lines.en: : Do you mind if I ask you something next, though?
lines.zh: : 不过接下来我能不能问你点事？

lines.en: scene mikuisheretoo22
: That depends. Is it going to completely undermine everything that we’ve discussed while I’ve been holding this slice of pizza?
lines.zh: : 那要看情况。这个问题会不会彻底推翻我拿着这块披萨期间我们所讨论的一切？

lines.en: : You know you...can eat that now. Right?
lines.zh: : 你知道你……现在可以吃了吗？

lines.en: : At this point, I may as well wait the twelve hours it will take for it to measure up to your standards.
lines.zh: : 到这一步，我还不如再等上十二个小时，好让它达到你的标准。

lines.en: scene mikuisheretoo23
: But yes...you can ask me something.
lines.zh: : 不过好吧……你可以问我点事。

lines.en: : Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : What brought this on? Why now?
lines.zh: : 是什么引起的？为什么是现在？

lines.en: : Did I do something recently to upset you or is it just...the buildup of everything {i}else{/i} I’ve done finally piling up so high that you can’t see the top anymore?
lines.zh: : 是我最近做了什么让你难过，还是……我做过的{i}所有事{/i}终于堆得太高，高到你都看不见顶了？

lines.en: : Neither.
lines.zh: : 都不是。

lines.en: : But this is likely where I start saying things that will make you think I’m entirely unfit for conversation at all.
lines.zh: : 不过接下来我说的话，大概会让你觉得我完全不适合跟人交谈。

lines.en: : Try me.
lines.zh: : 尽管说。

lines.en: : Are you sure?
lines.zh: : 你确定？

lines.en: : I can assure you that I’ve either heard or experienced things much worse than whatever you’re about to tell me.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，不管你要说什么，我都听过或经历过比这糟糕得多的事。

lines.en: : I’ve come to realize that basically anything is possible at this point.
lines.zh: : 我已经意识到，到这一步基本上什么都可能发生。

lines.en: : So even if you wind up being unfit for conversation with others, I’ll still talk to you.
lines.zh: : 所以就算你最终变得没法跟别人正常交流，我还是会跟你说话。

lines.en: : Then...forgive me for asking something so strange, but-
lines.zh: : 那么……请原谅我问了这么奇怪的问题，不过——

lines.en: scene mikuisheretoo24
: We’ve been here before, haven’t we?
lines.zh: : 我们以前来过这里，对吧？

lines.en: : Because I...remember it happening. But I don’t remember when.
lines.zh: : 因为我……记得它发生过。但我不记得是什么时候。

lines.en: : I even remember...something that happened between us in the bedroom that Miku is in right now.
lines.zh: : 我甚至记得……我们之间在 Miku 现在待的那间卧室里发生过的事。

lines.en: : And I...very much hope they changed the sheets.
lines.zh: : 而我……非常希望他们换过床单了。

lines.en: : Me too. It’s been like half a year since then.
lines.zh: : 我也是。从那以后大概过了半年。

lines.en: scene mikuisheretoo25
: So you {i}do{/i} remember!
lines.zh: : 所以你{i}真的{/i}记得！

lines.en: : Yes, I do. But all I can really say is that it was summer.
lines.zh: : 是，我记得。但我只能说，那是在夏天。

lines.en: : I still don’t understand enough to say anything more than that.
lines.zh: : 我了解的还不够多，说不出更多。

lines.en: : But we shouldn’t have known each other in the summer. This is our first year together as-
lines.zh: : 可我们在夏天还不该认识。这是我们在一起的第一年，作为——

lines.en: scene fly
scene mikuisheretoo26
: Ngh!
: Makoto? What’s wrong?
lines.zh: : Makoto？怎么了？

lines.en: : Nothing! Just...random migraine!
lines.zh: : 没事！只是……突然偏头痛！

lines.en: : There are...painkillers in Miku’s bag...
lines.zh: : Miku 的包里有……止痛药……

lines.en: : Got it. I’ll be right back.
lines.zh: : 知道了。我马上回来。

lines.en: : Th...Thanks...
scene black
I open the door to the bedroom and ask Miku if she can help me search for some sort of migraine medication for Makoto.
lines.zh: 我打开卧室的门，问 Miku 能不能帮我在她包里找找治偏头痛的药。

lines.en: She responds by dumping the entirety of her bag onto the bed and frantically pushing everything aside in search of the right bottle.
lines.zh: 她的反应是把包里的东西全倒在床上，然后发疯似地把东西一件件扒开，找那个对的小药瓶。

lines.en: We eventually find it after creating a huge mess that I leave her to take care of (Sorry, Miku) and then return to Makoto, who promptly swallows the pills without the aid of water.
lines.zh: 我们弄得一团糟之后终于找到了（抱歉了，Miku），我把烂摊子留给她收拾，然后回到 Makoto 身边，她二话不说就把药干吞了下去，连水都没喝。

lines.en: It’s funny how this action alone earns more respect for her in my book than everything she’s told me over the course of the last hour or two.
lines.zh: 有趣的是，单是这一个动作就为她在我这里赢得了比过去一两个小时里她说的所有话都更多的尊重。

lines.en: Our conversation never picks back up after that.
lines.zh: 从那以后，我们的对话再也没有接上。

lines.en: Instead, the two of us sit around for another hour or so, waiting for her headache to subside before finally making our way back out into the cold...
lines.zh: 我们俩反而又干坐了一个小时左右，等她头痛消下去，才终于重新走进外面的寒冷里……

lines.zh: {i}Makoto 的好感度提升到了 [makoto_love]！{/i}
